title: Paired acoustic / throat-vibration response geometry
dataset: TAPS: Throat and Acoustic Paired Speech Dataset (Korean)

synthetic_smoke_test.note: Synthetic fixtures validate ingestion, feature extraction, RDM, alignment and privacy behavior only. They are not TAPS observations and are not empirical voice findings.

critical_bandwidth_constraint.high_band_descriptor: 4000-7800 Hz, acoustic only; throat feature invalid because source Nyquist is 4 kHz

limitations: No emotion labels are documented; no emotion inference is performed.
No empirical TAPS waveform was downloaded or analyzed in this environment.
Synthetic smoke-test metrics must not be interpreted as empirical results.
The sensor channels have different physical meanings and calibration; raw sample amplitudes are not directly compared.
Within-speaker RDM correspondence tests relational alignment, not semantic equivalence or a universal invariant.
